# 08 Resolve namespaces, notes and annotations into the ClassModel

## Outcome

`buildClassModel` resolves namespace membership, note attachment and annotations: every namespace
gets a stable id and a validated member list, every attached note resolves its target class, and
annotations attach to their class.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each namespace resolves with a stable `namespace-${n}` id and its member class ids.
- [ ] A class named in two namespaces produces an error diagnostic, keeping the first — a class
  belongs to at most one namespace.
- [ ] A namespace naming a class that does not otherwise exist creates it implicitly, consistent
  with relationships doing the same.
- [ ] `note for X` resolves its target; a note targeting an unknown class produces an error
  diagnostic and the note is dropped, leaving the rest of the model intact.
- [ ] Free notes resolve with a stable `note-${n}` id and no target.
- [ ] An annotation attaches to its class; a class with two conflicting annotations produces a
  warning and keeps the first.
- [ ] Notes and namespaces are addressable from a `timeline:` block by their ids.

Two gaps round 2's review found in ticket 03's merge, which this ticket inherits and must close:

- [ ] Merging repeat declarations is a **union**, not a concatenation. Today
  `existing.members.push(...declaration.members)` appends unconditionally, so `Animal : +int age`
  written twice yields the member twice. Ticket 03's criterion said "union"; its test only merged
  distinct members, so the case went uncovered. Decide and document what makes two members the
  same (the composed line text is the obvious key) and test the duplicate case.
- [x] (Closed by an orchestrator integration fix in the parser, which this ticket could not
  reach from the model side.) Two conflicting `<<annotation>>` lines **inside one class block** kept the last
  silently, while two conflicting annotations across separate declarations warn. Make the two
  paths agree — one rule, one diagnostic.
